title: Enchiladas Suizas

ingredientGroups.title: Roasted Vegetables
items: 1 small white onion (cut in half from root to tip)

ingredientGroups.title: Sauce and Assembly
items: ½ a block of cream cheese
1 cup Mexican crema (or substitute with sour cream)
¼ cup oil for frying the tortillas, plus a drizzle for the vegetables

steps: Pre-heat oven on broil.
Add peppers, onion, and garlic to a sheet pan then drizzle with some oil and place it under the broiler. Roast for a few minutes, flipping ingredients as needed:
Reserve the garlic for the Instant Pot when it is golden brown on both sides. The garlic will be the first to brown so be careful not to burn it.
Reserve the onion for the Instant Pot when it is nicely charred.
When the peppers are charred on both sides, transfer to a container and cover to let the residual heat steam the skin.
Start Shredded Chicken while waiting for the peppers to steam.

After the peppers have sat covered for at least 3 minutes, remove the stems, skin, and deseed all the peppers. (pro-tip: slice each pepper in half lengthwise and use a measuring spoon or small spoon to quickly scrape the seeds and veins out. optionally leave the jalapeno and serrano seeds in if you like it spicy.)
Add chicken breasts, charred onion, charred garlic, bay leaves, pepper, coriander, salt, chicken bouillon, and water to the Instant Pot. Pressure cook on high for 15 minutes, then quick release.
Start Corn Tortillas while you wait for the chicken to cook.
Transfer the cooked chicken to a cutting board to cool slightly, leaving everything else in the Instant Pot for now.
Start Suizas Sauce while you wait for the chicken to cool.
Shred the chicken while the tomatillos are pressure cooking.
Mix ¾ cup of Suizas Sauce into the shredded chicken.
Heat ¼ cup oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Quickly fry the corn tortillas for approximately 3-5 seconds per side. The goal is to make the tortillas pliable without being crispy. Transfer to a plate and cover until Assembly.
Add tomatillos to the Instant Pot and bring to pressure. Quick release as soon as it comes to pressure.
Transfer the tomatillos, onion, garlic, and 1.5 cups of the chicken broth from the Instant Pot to a blender. The remainder of the broth can be reserved for Mexican rice.
Add the skinned peppers and a large handful of cilantro (all of the stems and a little of the leaves) to the blender and blend until smooth.
Add the cream cheese and Mexican crema and blend until incorporated.
Preheat oven to 400 F
Add enough Suizas Sauce to cover the bottom of a deep sheet pan, approximately 1 cup.
Fill each tortilla with 2 Tbsp Oaxaca cheese, 2 Tbsp shredded chicken, and a pinch of minced red onion if desired. Roll into 1-inch enchiladas and arrange in two rows.
Pour Suizas Sauce over the enchiladas and use the back of a large spoon to spread to evenly coat the corn tortillas.
Sprinkle the remainder of the Oaxaca cheese over the enchiladas.
Heat in the oven until the cheese is melted, approximately 10 minutes.
Garnish with Queso Fresco crumbles and chopped cilantro leaves
